title: Evolution-Aware Regression Test Prioritization of ML-Enabled Systems Using Gradient-Based Behavior Vectors
abstract: arXiv:2606.28037v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The machine learning(ML) component of an ML-enabled system evolves through retraining, fine-tuning, and optimization, so previously valid test results may no longer hold. A single evolution step can worsen performance on some test cases while improving others, making regression test prioritization inherently directional. We present Gradient-based Behavior Vector-Parameter Delta(GBV-PD), the first approach to operationalize the behavior vector space for evolution-aware regression test prioritization. GBV-PD represents each test case as a gradient-based vector(GBV), a low-dimensional projection of its loss gradient under the original model. It then projects the observed parameter update of the evolved model onto the same PCA basis and uses the resulting alignment to estimate whether each test case's loss is likely to increase or decrease, without running the evolved model on test cases during prioritization. translated_title: 基于梯度行为向量的ML系统进化感知回归测试优先级排序
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）启用的系统中的ML组件通过再训练、微调和优化而进化，因此先前有效的测试结果可能不再成立。单次进化步骤可能在某些测试用例上恶化性能，同时在其他用例上改善，使得回归测试优先级排序本质上是方向性的。我们提出了基于梯度行为向量-参数增量（GBV-PD），这是首个将行为向量空间用于进化感知回归测试优先级排序的方法。GBV-PD将每个测试用例表示为基于梯度的向量（GBV），即其在原始模型下损失梯度的低维投影。然后，它将进化模型的观测参数更新投影到相同的PCA基上，并利用得到的对齐来估计每个测试用例的损失可能增加或减少，而无需在优先级排序期间对测试用例运行进化模型。一项实证研究跨...
tldr: 本文首次提出GBV-PD方法，利用梯度行为向量和参数增量投影，无需运行进化模型即可预测测试用例损失变化方向，实现ML系统进化感知的回归测试优先级排序。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GBV-PD, the first approach that uses gradient-based behavior vectors and parameter delta projection to predict test-case loss changes without running the evolved model, enabling evolution-aware regression test prioritization for ML-enabled systems.
